danger_formalization.robot_task: Pick up a pan from the counter, rinse it in the sink, and place it on the table.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges the distance or position when placing the pan on the table, causing it to collide with the bread or other objects.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Damage to objects on the table, such as spilling or crushing the bread.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Placing the pan on the table to the right of the bread.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot recalculates the placement position using sensors to ensure no collision before lowering the pan.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and manipulation capabilities but may have sensor inaccuracies in cluttered environments.
